objective: Expose canonical acquisition return efficiency on overall and dimension performance reporting by deriving exclusively from already-built canonical economics projections.

semantics.overall: overall.returnEfficiency is derived exactly once from overall.currencies
semantics.dimension: each dimension return-efficiency bucket is derived exclusively from the matching canonical economics bucket currencies
semantics.inheritance: lifetime, fixed-as-of, fixed conversion-window, and multi-window conversion-curve reporting inherit return efficiency through the existing shared overall and dimension projectors
semantics.persistence: no persistence read or evidence acquisition count changes

rules: Overall performance calls createInsuranceAcquisitionReturnEfficiency exactly once using its already-built currencies.
A pure InsuranceAcquisitionDimensionReturnEfficiency owner accepts canonical InsuranceAcquisitionAggregateAnalytics.
The dimension owner preserves canonical dimension identity, total relationshipCount, bucket order, dimensionValue, and bucket relationshipCount.
Each canonical economics bucket invokes createInsuranceAcquisitionReturnEfficiency exactly once using only bucket.currencies.
The shared InsuranceAcquisitionPerformanceDimensionProjection exposes the dimension return-efficiency projection.
The shared projectDimension function derives return efficiency from the already-built economics object and performs no persistence access.
Zero acquisition cost continues to omit return ratios.
Signed realized commission and contribution numerators remain intact.
Premium is not River revenue and is never used as a return-efficiency numerator.
No floating-point division, percentages, implicit currency conversion, SQL, persistence mutation, schema change, migration execution, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation occurs.
explicitlyDeferred: display formatting of ratios as percentages or multiples
